title: Google Recipe
notes: Not checked: use cookTime and prepTime together, or totalTime, or both.
Not checked: HowToStep recommends name, image, url and video; HowToSection requires itemListElement and name; HowToStep requires text or itemListElement; HowToDirection and HowToTip require text.
Not checked: a recipe carousel (ItemList) requires itemListElement with position and url.
Required: image (URL or ImageObject; the completed dish) and name. nutrition.calories requires recipeYield. cookTime and prepTime are to be used together; or use totalTime (or both).
Durations are ISO 8601. recipeInstructions: HowToStep recommended;
HowToStep: required text OR itemListElement (HowToDirection/HowToTip); recommended image, name, url, video.
If a single review is present the reviewer name must be a valid person/organization.
Host carousel (ItemList): required itemListElement (ListItem) with position and url. keywords: comma separated, do not duplicate recipeCategory/recipeCuisine.
